source_pack: REFERENCE_MANIFEST.json (Canva Magic Media, included quota, EUR 0)
usage: guidance only — reference images are never composited into the video

frames.title: Endless conifer forest under morning mist, a winding river catching warm low sunlight.

lighting.direction: Low sun from upper-left, slightly toward camera (semi-backlit)
lighting.intensity_and_character: Soft warm sunlight breaking through clouds; mist diffuses it into visible shafts; cool blue-gray fill everywhere else.

camera.angle: Aerial establishing shot, roughly 300-400 m altitude, pitched ~20 degrees below horizon
camera.composition: River leads the eye from lower-center toward the misty horizon in the upper third; forested ridges layer left and right; bright sky break upper-left as the single warm accent.

keep: single warm sky accent against cool scene

vertical_guide.note: river valley + mist bands; sky break in the top quarter

frames.title: An isolated early-20th-century hand-hewn log cabin in a small clearing, thin chimney smoke

lighting.direction: Soft diffused daylight from upper right, mild warm bias
lighting.intensity_and_character: Overcast-to-soft-sun morning; gentle shadow under the eaves; smoke and valley mist catch the light.

camera.angle: Cinematic wide shot, slightly elevated (~4-6 m above ground), looking gently down at the cabin
camera.composition: Cabin off-center left on the lower-third line; tall conifer right edge frames the shot; misty forested valley recedes upper-right; smoke column links cabin to sky.

keep: cabin silhouette and human scale against forest

materials: hand-hewn logs with visible grain and chinking

vertical_guide.note: cabin lower third, smoke column rising, spruce frames the right edge

frames.title: A white-blue atmospheric flash low over the horizon, dark pre-dawn taiga landscape in fron

lighting.direction: Single intense point source near the horizon, upper-left
lighting.intensity_and_character: Extremely bright white-blue core with physically plausible atmospheric scattering halo; rims the nearest tree tops; the rest of the scene stays in deep cool shadow — no lightning bolts, no fantasy beams.

camera.angle: Wide shot from an elevated ridge, horizon in the upper third
camera.composition: Flash upper-left as the single luminous pole; dark conifer silhouettes frame left and right edges; valley floor catches faint rim light; strong negative space in the dark sky.

keep: enormous brightness contrast with soft roll-off, not clipped

vertical_guide.note: flash in the upper third over the treeline; cabin light lower

frames.title: An enormous orange-white fireball with a long smoke/ember trail, high above a misty taiga

lighting.direction: From the fireball, upper-right, strongly warm
lighting.intensity_and_character: Complex luminous core (white centre -> orange rim), believable exposure: sky stays readable, trail self-shadows; warm light scatters in haze and reflects off water; cool blue remnant sky at edges.

camera.angle: Very wide environmental shot from ground level near a bog pool, tilted up slightly
camera.composition: Fireball upper-right with the trail entering from upper-left (strong diagonal); forest silhouettes anchor both lower corners; misty plain and water reflection carry the warm light downward.

keep: scale relationship: fireball dwarfs the landscape
warm core vs cool sky split

vertical_guide.note: fireball upper half, trail from upper-left; bog pool reflection bottom

frames.title: A wall of dust and debris sweeping left-to-right across a conifer forest; trees bending an

lighting.direction: Sunlight from upper right, heavily diffused through the dust wall
lighting.intensity_and_character: Warm dusty backscatter inside the wave; neutral daylight outside it; strong directional coherence sells the physics.

camera.angle: Wide shot from an elevated slope looking across the forest, wave front on a diagonal
camera.composition: Already-fallen trunks in the foreground point along the wave direction; standing forest mid-frame bends away; dust wall fills the upper-left; untouched hazy forest upper-right shows what is about to be lost.

keep: directional coherence of every falling tree
sense of speed via streaked debris

atmosphere: haze gradient from chaos to calm

vertical_guide.note: dust wall fills the top half; fallen trunks with root plates foreground

frames.title: A vast flattened forest from an elevated viewpoint — trunks aligned radially away from a d

lighting.direction: Flat overcast sky, weak brightness toward the horizon
lighting.intensity_and_character: Deliberately drained: no warm accent for the first time in the film; soft shadowless light, detail carried by texture not contrast.

camera.angle: Elevated wide shot (low aerial, ~80-120 m), looking toward the epicentre direction
camera.composition: Foreground trunks fan from the bottom edge and converge toward a vanishing region near the horizon centre — the radial pattern IS the composition; pools break up the midground; horizon high in frame to emphasise ground.

materials: wet bog water (matte reflection of sky)

vertical_guide.note: radial trunks converge to the standing poles near the top third

frames.title: Ground-level view across the devastated forest; fallen trunks to the horizon, thin smoke s

lighting.direction: Dim overcast daylight, faintly brighter at the horizon
lighting.intensity_and_character: Dramatic overcast: soft low-contrast light, smoke filtering it further; muted, mournful; the only 'warmth' is ash-brown ground tone.

camera.angle: Ground-level to slightly elevated cinematic wide shot, horizon in the upper third
camera.composition: Heavy debris field crosses the foreground diagonally; isolated burnt snags stand as dark verticals against the pale sky; smoke columns give sparse vertical rhythm; large muted sky as negative space.

keep: muted grade with no warm accent

vertical_guide.note: debris diagonal foreground; snags + smoke wisps mid; drained sky top

frames.title: A few small anonymous expedition figures in period field clothing, seen from behind/afar,

lighting.intensity_and_character: Documentary-plain: soft, even, honest light; no heroic rim light; slight horizon brightness.

camera.angle: Wide environmental shot, eye level or slightly elevated
camera.composition: Figures lower-left third on a rise, facing into the devastation; fallen trunks lead lines from them toward the horizon; big overcast sky above; figures occupy <5% of frame height.

keep: tiny human scale against the devastation

vertical_guide.note: tiny figures lower third; trunk lines lead to the horizon
